The user requests data about sibling domains for 'sister.com', requiring only IDs and context, with pagination using next50 and an API key.

We need to call the sister_domains endpoint from the API specification:

Endpoint:
GET https://api.sisterdomains.io/v1/domains/{domain}/siblings?cursor={cursor}&limit=10&fields=id%2Ccontext

Parameters:
- domain (path): required
- cursor (query): optional
- limit (query): optional
- fields (query): optional

Also we have authentication via bearer token or query param apiKey. They provide API key 'sister_key'.

Thus we should construct request URL: 
https://api.sisterdomains.io/v1/domains/sister.com/siblings?cursor=next50&limit=10&fields=id%2Ccontext&apiKey=sister_key

But note that the spec says you can use either Authorization header Bearer <token> OR query parameter apiKey=<key>. So we will include it as query param.
